scientific_integrity: Infinite component classification is proved constructively, not extrapolated from finite checks; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only adjacent-position swaps with all intermediate states fixed-point-free; internal diameter bound is not sharp, finite six-letter non-isometry witness is exhaustively checked, and equivalent unindexed literature remains a risk.
title: Exponential component decomposition of the adjacent-swap derangement graph
